arguments.question: Did the latest FOMC policy communication identify financing conditions or interest rates that could materially alter AI-infrastructure capital availability over NVIDIA’s next 21/63 sessions? Please cite evidence and distinguish policy fact from transmission inference.
arguments.decision_impact: NVIDIA’s Q2 materials cite third-party compute-financing platforms and >$500bn potential capital mobilization; whether rates/financial conditions affect that channel is material, but issuer disclosures do not quantify sensitivity.
